<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Congress leadership strategy:</strong> Rahul Gandhi is set to address audiences in the U.S. while the party implements a dual-track approach in Uttar Pradesh, utilizing Rahul as a street fighter and Priyanka Gandhi as a strategist.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election Commission oversight:</strong> The Election Commission of India is currently awaiting a report regarding claims of separatist links involving the group &#x27;Waris Punjab de&#x27;.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Local election outcomes:</strong> The BJP has secured 77 seats unopposed in Tripura&#x27;s civic body elections, with voting for the remaining seats scheduled for November 27.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Institutional integrity concerns:</strong> Allegations of political interference have emerged in local governance and sports bodies, with reports of government directors influencing cooperative polls in Kolhapur and disputes surrounding the Indian Olympic Association elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
</ul>
